extraFacts.fact: API 598 covers the inspection and testing of valves, including shell, backseat and seat tests; API 609 covers butterfly valves (lug, wafer and double-flanged types, Category A and Category B); API 600 covers bolted-bonnet steel gate valves; API 602 covers compact steel gate, globe and check valves of small bore; API 603 covers corrosion-resistant bolted-bonnet gate valves; API 6D covers pipeline valves; API 594 covers wafer, lug and flanged check valves; API 599 covers metal plug valves; API 607 is the fire test for valves with non-metallic seats; BS 1868 covers steel check valves and BS 1873 steel globe valves; ASME B16.34 covers valve pressure-temperature ratings and ASME B16.10 covers valve face-to-face lengths; EN 10204 3.1 is the inspection certificate type for material certificates; ISO 15848 covers fugitive emissions of valves.

faqs.q: What are Banjo check valves used for?
faqs.a: Banjo check valves are polypropylene one-way valves that stop liquid flowing backwards in tank, sprayer and manifold lines. The range has 24 part numbers rated 150 to 300 psi (10 to 21 bar) by size; see the [industrial check valves shelf](/c/industrial-check-valves).

faqs.q: How do I read the Banjo check valve part numbers?
faqs.a: The rows show a base number and a letter suffix for the seal: 12705 is the check valve and 12705BN is the same valve in Buna N. Quote the full number from the old valve.

faqs.q: What pressure are Banjo check valves rated for?
faqs.a: The maker states 150 to 300 psi (10 to 21 bar), by size, in polypropylene. Check the row for your part number, because the rating changes with size.

faqs.q: What material are Banjo check valves made of?
faqs.a: Polypropylene, in black. Polypropylene suits many acids, alkalis and fertiliser solutions; check your chemical against the seal material before ordering.

faqs.q: Which fluids suit the Banjo check valves?
faqs.a: Give the fluid and temperature when you request a quotation for the Banjo check valves: the body and seal material are chosen against it, and the rows show the seal options listed.

faqs.q: Does Indus supply test documents with the Banjo check valves?
faqs.a: No certificate or approval is listed for the Banjo check valves. If your project needs a test report or a certificate of conformity, state it on your [request](/contact) and we confirm what is available before supply.

faqs.q: What do I check before fitting the Banjo check valves?
faqs.a: Check the size, connection and seal material against your fluid, and the pressure against the listed rating. For the Banjo check valves the size table shows examples such as CV050 and CV051.

faqs.q: How do I order the Banjo check valves?
faqs.a: Quote the part number, such as 12705, 12705BN and CV101MT, with the size and options you need; 24 part numbers are listed for the Banjo check valves. Price and lead time are confirmed with the quotation.

faqs.q: Where are the Banjo check valves used?
faqs.a: The Banjo check valves are used on chemical, water and utility lines to stop reverse flow; see the [industrial check valve types guide](/blog/industrial-check-valve-types) for how swing, lift and other checks differ.

faqs.q: How do Banjo check valves compare with the Plast-O-Matic CK series?
faqs.a: The Banjo valves are polypropylene with 24 part numbers, while the [Plast-O-Matic CK series](/p/plast-o-matic-ck-series-check-valves) has 8 part numbers in PTFE with socket or NPT ends and EPDM seals.

faqs.q: Can the Banjo check valves be shipped from Dubai?
faqs.a: The listing gives United States as the country of origin. We ship the Banjo check valves from Dubai, UAE to the GCC, Africa, Asia and beyond; tell us the destination so the documents match.

faqs.q: Are Banjo check valves in stock in Dubai?
faqs.a: Yes, we hold Banjo check valves in stock at our warehouse in Dubai, UAE, and ship worldwide with the best lead times. Quote the part numbers you need on [our contact page](/contact).

faqs.q: What is the API 6D axial flow check valve used for?
faqs.a: The API 6D axial flow check valve is a axial flow (nozzle) check valve built to API 6D, ASME B16.34, used for pump and compressor discharge, pipelines, high-flow systems. It is made in NPS 2" to 60" (DN50 to DN1500) and ASME Class 150 to 2500, and is built to order and supplied from Dubai; see the [check valves](/c/industrial-check-valves).

faqs.q: How do I read the API 6D axial flow check valve part numbers such as IH-PV-AFC-L-2500-0400?
faqs.a: In the size table IH-PV-AFC-L-2500-0400 is the 4" Long pattern valve in Class 2500: the number before the size is the class, and the last four digits are the size in hundredths of an inch, and L is "Long pattern". The table lists 206 size and class combinations.

faqs.q: What sizes and classes is the API 6D axial flow check valve available in?
faqs.a: The published range for the API 6D axial flow check valve is NPS 2" to 60" (DN50 to DN1500), in ASME Class 150 to 2500. The size table lists 206 size and class combinations with lengths and weights, so you can check the valve against the piping layout.

faqs.q: What pressure and temperature can the API 6D axial flow check valve take?
faqs.a: The API 6D axial flow check valve is rated ASME Class 150 to 2500. The rating falls as temperature rises, so give the design pressure and temperature of the line and we confirm the class and material.

faqs.q: What materials is the API 6D axial flow check valve made in?
faqs.a: The body is available in carbon steel, stainless steel, alloy steel, duplex, with metal-seated disc. The construction is Venturi body, spring-assisted axial disc.

faqs.q: What tests and documents come with the API 6D axial flow check valve?
faqs.a: Each API 6D axial flow check valve has hydrostatic shell and seat tests to API 6D, with the material certificates (EN 10204 3.1) and the pressure-test record supplied. Third-party inspection and extra tests are added when the order specifies them.

faqs.q: How is the API 6D axial flow check valve operated, and what end connections does it have?
faqs.a: The API 6D axial flow check valve has RF, RTJ flanged; butt-weld ends and is operated by self-acting, spring-assisted. Say which operator and end connection you need, and give the pipe schedule for butt-weld ends.

faqs.q: API 6D axial flow check valve: Why choose an axial flow check on a compressor discharge?
faqs.a: Its fast, spring-assisted closing stops reverse flow within milliseconds of a trip, protecting the compressor, and it stays quiet and stable under pulsating flow where a swing check would chatter.

faqs.q: API 6D axial flow check valve: Does it need straight pipe upstream?
faqs.a: Like any check valve it works best with steady flow; allow several diameters of straight pipe after pumps, elbows and reducers. We will review the layout with the sizing.

faqs.q: How does the API 6D axial flow check valve compare with the API 594 dual plate check valve?
faqs.a: The API 6D axial flow check valve differs from the [API 594 dual plate check valve](/p/dual-plate-check-valve-api-594) in construction: venturi body, spring-assisted axial disc here, twin spring-loaded plates on central hinge pin on the other. Also, standard: API 6D, ASME B16.34 here, API 594, ASME B16.34 on the other. This valve is for pump and compressor discharge, pipelines, high-flow systems; the other is for process, cooling water, seawater and pump discharge.

faqs.q: Where is the API 6D axial flow check valve supplied from?
faqs.a: The API 6D axial flow check valve is built to order to your specification and supplied from Dubai, UAE to projects, plants and maintenance teams across the GCC, the wider Middle East and Africa. Delivery depends on size, class, material and operator; standard carbon-steel sizes move fastest.

faqs.q: Is the API 6D axial flow check valve in stock in Dubai?
faqs.a: Yes, we carry the API 6D axial flow check valve in stock at our warehouse in Dubai, UAE, and ship worldwide with the best lead times. Built-to-order specifications are quoted with their own delivery time. Request pricing for your sizes through [our contact page](/contact).

faqs.q: What is the BS 1868 cast steel swing check valve used for?
faqs.a: The BS 1868 cast steel swing check valve is a swing check valve built to BS 1868 (DN 15–600), ASME B16.34, used for pump discharge, process and utility lines. It is made in NPS 2" to 60" (DN50 to DN1500) and ASME Class 150 to 2500, and is built to order and supplied from Dubai; see the [check valves](/c/industrial-check-valves).

faqs.q: What pressure and temperature can the BS 1868 cast steel swing check valve take?
faqs.a: The BS 1868 cast steel swing check valve is rated ASME Class 150 to 2500. The rating falls as temperature rises, so give the design pressure and temperature of the line and we confirm the class and material.

faqs.q: What materials is the BS 1868 cast steel swing check valve made in?
faqs.a: The body is available in carbon steel, low-temperature steel, alloy steel, stainless steel, with hardfaced, seal-welded seat. The construction is Bolted cover, swing disc on hinge pin.

faqs.q: What tests and documents come with the BS 1868 cast steel swing check valve?
faqs.a: Each BS 1868 cast steel swing check valve has shell and seat tests to API 598, with the material certificates (EN 10204 3.1) and the pressure-test record supplied. Third-party inspection and extra tests are added when the order specifies them.

faqs.q: How is the BS 1868 cast steel swing check valve operated, and what end connections does it have?
faqs.a: The BS 1868 cast steel swing check valve has RF, RTJ flanged; butt-weld ends and is operated by self-acting; damper or lever and weight on request. Say which operator and end connection you need, and give the pipe schedule for butt-weld ends.

faqs.q: BS 1868 cast steel swing check valve: Can it be installed vertically?
faqs.a: Yes, with the flow upward, so the disc closes under its own weight. With flow downward a swing check cannot close and a spring-assisted check valve is needed.

faqs.q: BS 1868 cast steel swing check valve: Why does my swing check chatter?
faqs.a: A swing disc needs enough steady flow to hold it fully open. At low flow it floats part-open and wears the hinge. If the flow is below the valve size, step the size down or choose a dual-plate or axial-flow check.

faqs.q: How does the BS 1868 cast steel swing check valve compare with the tilting disc check valve?
faqs.a: The BS 1868 cast steel swing check valve differs from the [tilting disc check valve](/p/tilting-disc-check-valve) in construction: bolted cover, swing disc on hinge pin here, off-centre pivoted disc, bolted or pressure-seal cover on the other. Also, standard: BS 1868 (DN 15–600), ASME B16.34 here, ASME B16.34 on the other. This valve is for pump discharge, process and utility lines; the other is for high-temperature steam, refining, petrochemical, hydrogenation.
